facts.fact: Amrita 在酒馆等迟到二十分钟时，Jamie 的钟被魔法拨慢，秒针周围有微光。
facts.anchor: he could clearly see the tell-tale glimmer around the second hand

facts.fact: Aiden 劝 Jamie 相信魔法的时机安排，即使它让人 frustrated。
facts.anchor: you’ve got to trust that the magic knows what it’s doing

facts.fact: Aiden 解释 Lunar 的鸟语：普通人听到模仿的人声，有天赋的人听到另一种说话。
facts.anchor: then there’s the speech people like me, Ophelia and Rayenne hear

facts.fact: 麻雀窗前的早晨，小精灵对 Amrita 施了一个她察觉不到的咒，只留下「Only slightly differently」。
facts.anchor: She didn’t hear the tiny spell – and wouldn’t have understood it even if she had been allowed to know the words

facts.fact: Aiden 骑车进镇时发现通往老 Cherry Blossom Inn 的出售牌不见了。
facts.anchor: At the crossroads before town, he noticed the for-sale sign on the tiny road to the old Cherry Blossom Inn had disappeared

facts.fact: Amrita 扫车上的落花，几朵粘在车窗上，凑成一个粗略的心形。
facts.anchor: forming the rough shape of a heart on her window

facts.fact: 章末 Mist 与 Lunar 对话：它们有「计划」，不干预人类婚礼的混乱，理由是「为他们好」。
facts.anchor: We stick to the plan, and work with the magic

facts.fact: Mia 面对婚礼全线崩盘（无场地、无餐饮、无证婚人、无礼服）仍说只要有 Aiden 就够。
facts.anchor: There’s nothing more right than you and me together
